target: Observed LTFJ ceiling strictly below 500 ft AGL within (t,t+3h], currently not below threshold
comparison: Fixed v2 local boosting configuration fitted separately with LOCAL and LOCAL+20 GFS inputs, same matched origins; no new hyperparameter search
calibration_rule: 2024 intercept-only log-odds adjustment; highest precision threshold with at least 70 percent positive-origin recall
evaluation: Brier, log loss, average precision, calibration, false alarms, positive-origin recall, event recall; paired 7-day block intervals
guardrails: Coverage gate is an engineering requirement, not evidence of unbiased missingness.
